name: small-bugfix
description: A small Python HTTP client gains retry with exponential backoff on 5xx responses. One source file, one test file. The brief should name the retry/backoff behaviour, keep risk low-to-medium, and classify the test file as a test.

pr.title: Retry GET requests on 5xx with exponential backoff
pr.body:
Intermittent 502/503s from the billing gateway during deploys were surfacing as hard failures in the SDK.

`Client.get` now retries up to 4 times on any 5xx with full-jitter exponential backoff (0.5s base, 4s cap). 4xx responses are still raised immediately. Tests cover retry-then-succeed, giving up after the last attempt, and no retry on 404.

Fixes #311.
pr.author: mira-k

files.patch:
diff --git a/httpclient/client.py b/httpclient/client.py
index 3f1c2a9..8be41d7 100644
--- a/httpclient/client.py
+++ b/httpclient/client.py
@@ -1,9 +1,14 @@
 from __future__ import annotations
 
 import json
+import random
+import time
 import urllib.error
 import urllib.request
 
+MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4
+BASE_DELAY = 0.5
+
 
 class HTTPError(Exception):
     def __init__(self, status: int, body: str) -> None:
@@ -17,11 +22,23 @@ class Client:
         self._base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
         self._timeout = timeout
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _backoff(attempt: int) -> float:
+        # Full jitter keeps a fleet of clients from retrying in lockstep after a
+        # shared outage; the cap keeps four attempts under roughly eight seconds.
+        return random.uniform(0, min(BASE_DELAY * (2**attempt), 4.0))
+
     def get(self, path: str) -> dict:
         url = f"{self._base_url}/{path.lstrip('/')}"
         req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Accept": "application/json"})
-        try:
-            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self._timeout) as resp:
-                return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
-        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
-            raise HTTPError(exc.code, exc.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")) from exc
+        for attempt in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
+            try:
+                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self._timeout) as resp:
+                    return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+            except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
+                # Only 5xx is retried: a 4xx will not change on a second try, and
+                # honoring 429 properly needs Retry-After, which is out of scope.
+                if exc.code < 500 or attempt == MAX_ATTEMPTS - 1:
+                    raise HTTPError(exc.code, exc.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")) from exc
+                time.sleep(self._backoff(attempt))
+        raise AssertionError("retry loop exited without a response")

diff --git a/tests/test_client.py b/tests/test_client.py
index 91ac0de..c47b3e2 100644
--- a/tests/test_client.py
+++ b/tests/test_client.py
@@ -1,6 +1,9 @@
+import io
 import json
+import urllib.error
 from unittest import mock
 
 import pytest
 
-from httpclient.client import Client, HTTPError
+from httpclient import client as client_module
+from httpclient.client import MAX_ATTEMPTS, Client, HTTPError
@@ -13,6 +16,36 @@ def _response(status: int, payload: dict) -> mock.MagicMock:
     return resp
 
 
+def _http_error(status: int) -> urllib.error.HTTPError:
+    return urllib.error.HTTPError("https://api.example.com/x", status, "err", {}, io.BytesIO(b"{}"))
+
+
 def test_get_parses_json() -> None:
     with mock.patch("urllib.request.urlopen", return_value=_response(200, {"ok": True})):
         assert Client("https://api.example.com").get("/health") == {"ok": True}
+
+
+def test_get_retries_5xx_then_succeeds(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setattr(client_module.time, "sleep", lambda _s: None)
+    urlopen = mock.Mock(side_effect=[_http_error(503), _http_error(502), _response(200, {"ok": 1})])
+    with mock.patch("urllib.request.urlopen", urlopen):
+        assert Client("https://api.example.com").get("/x") == {"ok": 1}
+    assert urlopen.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_get_gives_up_after_max_attempts(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    sleeps: list[float] = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(client_module.time, "sleep", sleeps.append)
+    with mock.patch("urllib.request.urlopen", side_effect=_http_error(500)):
+        with pytest.raises(HTTPError) as info:
+            Client("https://api.example.com").get("/x")
+    assert info.value.status == 500
+    assert len(sleeps) == MAX_ATTEMPTS - 1
+
+
+def test_get_does_not_retry_4xx() -> None:
+    urlopen = mock.Mock(side_effect=_http_error(404))
+    with mock.patch("urllib.request.urlopen", urlopen):
+        with pytest.raises(HTTPError):
+            Client("https://api.example.com").get("/missing")
+    assert urlopen.call_count == 1
